result.summary: The interface contains several elements that appear as placeholders or data errors, typical of a prototype or unpopulated environment.

issues.description: Restaurant cards use generic vector illustrations rather than real food photography.
issues.suggestion: Implement actual merchant imagery to improve visual credibility.

issues.description: A promotional badge displays a '-100%' discount, which appears to be a data error.
issues.suggestion: Verify discount calculation logic to ensure realistic values.

issues.description: Restaurant titles in the horizontal carousel are truncated prematurely.
issues.suggestion: Adjust text containers or font sizing to improve readability.
